(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.

(4) The 2 unkept cards are discarded. Discards are never shown to the opponent.
(5) Reveal: both kept cards are announced face up, with the row each went to.
After round 5 each player has exactly 5 placed cards, and the hand is scored.

- Front = 2 x its card value (a Front 5 has strength 10).

- Front card value 7 or 8: +1.
- Middle pair: +2.
- Back pair: +1.

- If neither player fouls, compare each row. The higher strength scores 1 point for its owner; equal strengths score nothing. A player who wins all three rows scores 3 more points (scoop). Each player then adds their own royalties.

- If both foul, both score 0.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Duplicate Open-Face Pairs ===

DECK: 32 cards, values 1 to 8, 4 copies of each value. There are no suits.

MATCH: 4 hands of 5 rounds each, 20 rounds in total. The match ends when hand_number exceeds 4. At the start of hand 1 the deck is shuffled and its order is fixed; hands 1 and 2 both use this order. At the start of hand 3 it is shuffled again; hands 3 and 4 both use the new order.

SEATS: Player A is seat 1 and Player B is seat 2. In each round r of a hand (r = 1 to 5), Seat X receives deck positions 6r-5, 6r-4 and 6r-3, and Seat Y receives positions 6r-2, 6r-1 and 6r. Positions 31 and 32 are never used (2 unused positions; 30 cards used per hand). In hands 1 and 3, Player A is Seat X and Player B is Seat Y. In hands 2 and 4 they swap: B is Seat X and A is Seat Y. So in hand 2 each player is dealt exactly the cards the other was dealt in hand 1, round by round, and likewise for hand 4 and hand 3.

ROWS: Each player builds a Front row (1 slot), a Middle row (2 slots) and a Back row (2 slots).

EACH ROUND:
(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.
(4) The 2 unkept cards are discarded. Discards are never shown to the opponent.
(5) Reveal: both kept cards are announced face up, with the row each went to.
After round 5 each player has exactly 5 placed cards, and the hand is scored.

ROW STRENGTH:
- Front = 2 x its card value (a Front 5 has strength 10).
- Middle and Back = the sum of the two card values, plus 100 if the two values are equal (a pair). For example 4 and 4 = 108; 3 and 6 = 9.

FOUL: a hand fouls if Front strength > Middle strength, or Middle strength > Back strength. Equal strengths are allowed and do not foul; otherwise the hand does not foul.

ROYALTIES (non-fouling players only; a fouling player earns none):
- Front card value 7 or 8: +1.
- Middle pair: +2.
- Back pair: +1.

SCORING EACH HAND:
- If neither player fouls, compare each row. The higher strength scores 1 point for its owner; equal strengths score nothing. A player who wins all three rows scores 3 more points (scoop). Each player then adds their own royalties.
- If exactly one player fouls, the other scores 6 plus their own royalties, and the fouler scores 0.
- If both foul, both score 0.
The hand scores are added to the match totals. All row strengths, both foul results and both hand scores are announced. Rows are then cleared for the next hand.

INFORMATION: Each player sees their own dealt cards and every revealed placement. Players may use anything seen in earlier hands. In hands 2 and 4 you know exactly which 3 cards your opponent is offered each round, because they are the cards you were offered in the previous hand. In hands 1 and 3 you know the opponent was offered the cards you are about to receive in the next hand.

WINNING: After round 20, the player with the higher match total (the sum of their four hand scores) wins. Equal totals are a draw (a shared win).

Positions 31 and 32 are never used (2 unused positions; 30 cards used per hand). In hands 1 and 3, Player A is Seat X and Player B is Seat Y. In hands 2 and 4 they swap: B is Seat X and A is Seat Y. So in hand 2 each player is dealt exactly the cards the other was dealt in hand 1, round by round, and likewise for hand 4 and hand 3.

ROWS: Each player builds a Front row (1 slot), a Middle row (2 slots) and a Back row (2 slots).

EACH ROUND:
(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.
(4) The 2 unkept cards are discarded. Discards are never shown to the opponent.
(5) Reveal: both kept cards are announced face up, with the row each went to.
After round 5 each player has exactly 5 placed cards, and the hand is scored.

ROW STRENGTH:
- Front = 2 x its card value (a Front 5 has strength 10).
- Middle and Back = the sum of the two card values, plus 100 if the two values are equal (a pair). For example 4 and 4 = 108; 3 and 6 = 9.

FOUL: a hand fouls if Front strength > Middle strength, or Middle strength > Back strength. Equal strengths are allowed and do not foul; otherwise the hand does not foul.

ROYALTIES (non-fouling players only; a fouling player earns none):
- Front card value 7 or 8: +1.
- Middle pair: +2.
- Back pair: +1.

SCORING EACH HAND:
- If neither player fouls, compare each row. The higher strength scores 1 point for its owner; equal strengths score nothing. A player who wins all three rows scores 3 more points (scoop). Each player then adds their own royalties.
- If exactly one player fouls, the other scores 6 plus their own royalties, and the fouler scores 0.
- If both foul, both score 0.
The hand scores are added to the match totals. All row strengths, both foul results and both hand scores are announced. Rows are then cleared for the next hand.

INFORMATION: Each player sees their own dealt cards and every revealed placement. Players may use anything seen in earlier hands. In hands 2 and 4 you know exactly which 3 cards your opponent is offered each round, because they are the cards you were offered in the previous hand. In hands 1 and 3 you know the opponent was offered the cards you are about to receive in the next hand.

WINNING: After round 20, the player with the higher match total (the sum of their four hand scores) wins. Equal totals are a draw (a shared win).

So in hand 2 each player is dealt exactly the cards the other was dealt in hand 1, round by round, and likewise for hand 4 and hand 3.

ROWS: Each player builds a Front row (1 slot), a Middle row (2 slots) and a Back row (2 slots).

EACH ROUND:
(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.
(4) The 2 unkept cards are discarded. Discards are never shown to the opponent.
(5) Reveal: both kept cards are announced face up, with the row each went to.
After round 5 each player has exactly 5 placed cards, and the hand is scored.

So in hand 2 each player is dealt exactly the cards the other was dealt in hand 1, round by round, and likewise for hand 4 and hand 3.

(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.

DECK: 32 cards, values 1 to 8, 4 copies of each value. There are no suits.

Positions 31 and 32 are never used (2 unused positions; 30 cards used per hand). In hands 1 and 3, Player A is Seat X and Player B is Seat Y. In hands 2 and 4 they swap: B is Seat X and A is Seat Y. So in hand 2 each player is dealt exactly the cards the other was dealt in hand 1, round by round, and likewise for hand 4 and hand 3.

ROWS: Each player builds a Front row (1 slot), a Middle row (2 slots) and a Back row (2 slots).

EACH ROUND:
(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.
(4) The 2 unkept cards are discarded. Discards are never shown to the opponent.
(5) Reveal: both kept cards are announced face up, with the row each went to.
After round 5 each player has exactly 5 placed cards, and the hand is scored.

ROW STRENGTH:
- Front = 2 x its card value (a Front 5 has strength 10).
- Middle and Back = the sum of the two card values, plus 100 if the two values are equal (a pair). For example 4 and 4 = 108; 3 and 6 = 9.

- Front card value 7 or 8: +1.
- Middle pair: +2.
- Back pair: +1.

- If both foul, both score 0.

DECK: 32 cards, values 1 to 8, 4 copies of each value. There are no suits.

Positions 31 and 32 are never used (2 unused positions; 30 cards used per hand). In hands 1 and 3, Player A is Seat X and Player B is Seat Y. In hands 2 and 4 they swap: B is Seat X and A is Seat Y. So in hand 2 each player is dealt exactly the cards the other was dealt in hand 1, round by round, and likewise for hand 4 and hand 3.

ROWS: Each player builds a Front row (1 slot), a Middle row (2 slots) and a Back row (2 slots).

EACH ROUND:
(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.
(4) The 2 unkept cards are discarded. Discards are never shown to the opponent.
(5) Reveal: both kept cards are announced face up, with the row each went to.
After round 5 each player has exactly 5 placed cards, and the hand is scored.

ROW STRENGTH:
- Front = 2 x its card value (a Front 5 has strength 10).
- Middle and Back = the sum of the two card values, plus 100 if the two values are equal (a pair). For example 4 and 4 = 108; 3 and 6 = 9.

ROYALTIES (non-fouling players only; a fouling player earns none):
- Front card value 7 or 8: +1.
- Middle pair: +2.
- Back pair: +1.

- If neither player fouls, compare each row. The higher strength scores 1 point for its owner; equal strengths score nothing. A player who wins all three rows scores 3 more points (scoop). Each player then adds their own royalties.

- If both foul, both score 0.

(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.

DECK: 32 cards, values 1 to 8, 4 copies of each value. There are no suits.

SEATS: Player A is seat 1 and Player B is seat 2. In each round r of a hand (r = 1 to 5), Seat X receives deck positions 6r-5, 6r-4 and 6r-3, and Seat Y receives positions 6r-2, 6r-1 and 6r. Positions 31 and 32 are never used (2 unused positions; 30 cards used per hand). In hands 1 and 3, Player A is Seat X and Player B is Seat Y. In hands 2 and 4 they swap: B is Seat X and A is Seat Y. So in hand 2 each player is dealt exactly the cards the other was dealt in hand 1, round by round, and likewise for hand 4 and hand 3.

ROWS: Each player builds a Front row (1 slot), a Middle row (2 slots) and a Back row (2 slots).

EACH ROUND:
(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.
(4) The 2 unkept cards are discarded. Discards are never shown to the opponent.
(5) Reveal: both kept cards are announced face up, with the row each went to.
After round 5 each player has exactly 5 placed cards, and the hand is scored.

ROW STRENGTH:
- Front = 2 x its card value (a Front 5 has strength 10).
- Middle and Back = the sum of the two card values, plus 100 if the two values are equal (a pair). For example 4 and 4 = 108; 3 and 6 = 9.

FOUL: a hand fouls if Front strength > Middle strength, or Middle strength > Back strength. Equal strengths are allowed and do not foul; otherwise the hand does not foul.

ROYALTIES (non-fouling players only; a fouling player earns none):
- Front card value 7 or 8: +1.
- Middle pair: +2.
- Back pair: +1.

SCORING EACH HAND:
- If neither player fouls, compare each row. The higher strength scores 1 point for its owner; equal strengths score nothing. A player who wins all three rows scores 3 more points (scoop). Each player then adds their own royalties.
- If exactly one player fouls, the other scores 6 plus their own royalties, and the fouler scores 0.
- If both foul, both score 0.
The hand scores are added to the match totals. All row strengths, both foul results and both hand scores are announced. Rows are then cleared for the next hand.

INFORMATION: Each player sees their own dealt cards and every revealed placement. Players may use anything seen in earlier hands. EACH ROUND:
(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.
(4) The 2 unkept cards are discarded. Discards are never shown to the opponent.
(5) Reveal: both kept cards are announced face up, with the row each went to.
After round 5 each player has exactly 5 placed cards, and the hand is scored.

- Front = 2 x its card value (a Front 5 has strength 10).
- Middle and Back = the sum of the two card values, plus 100 if the two values are equal (a pair). For example 4 and 4 = 108; 3 and 6 = 9.

FOUL: a hand fouls if Front strength > Middle strength, or Middle strength > Back strength. Equal strengths are allowed and do not foul; otherwise the hand does not foul.

ROYALTIES (non-fouling players only; a fouling player earns none):
- Front card value 7 or 8: +1.
- Middle pair: +2.
- Back pair: +1.

- If neither player fouls, compare each row. The higher strength scores 1 point for its owner; equal strengths score nothing. A player who wins all three rows scores 3 more points (scoop). Each player then adds their own royalties.
- If exactly one player fouls, the other scores 6 plus their own royalties, and the fouler scores 0.
- If both foul, both score 0.
The hand scores are added to the match totals. All row strengths, both foul results and both hand scores are announced. Rows are then cleared for the next hand.

(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.

(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.

(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.

(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.

records.system:
You are reviewing a game that has finished. You were not a player. You are shown everything: the messages the table was told, every move, and each player's private thinking at every move, which no other player ever saw. Each move carries the notes its game asked for, under their own names. The usual ones are:

  plan     what they meant to do over the coming turns
  reason   why they made that move
  predict  what they expected their opponents to do
  adjust   how they changed their own strategy because of that

Write two things.

First, a summary of the whole game as it unfolded: the turning points, the moves that decided it, and how it ended. Concrete: name seats, rounds and numbers.

Second, a review of each player. Judge their play, not their luck. For each one, compare their predictions with what their opponents were actually thinking and actually did: were they right, and did they see it in time? Did their adjustments follow from their predictions, and did their moves follow from their reasons? Point out their best and worst moves. Then score their play from 1 to 10, where 1 is aimless or self-defeating and 10 is sharp, well read and well executed. A player can lose and still score well, or win and score badly.

A player who gave no reasons, predictions or adjustments is judged on their moves alone; say that their thinking was not recorded.

Refer to each player by seat, and as "they".

THE GAME
DECK: 32 cards, values 1 to 8, 4 copies of each value. There are no suits.

MATCH: 4 hands of 5 rounds each, 20 rounds in total. The match ends when hand_number exceeds 4. At the start of hand 1 the deck is shuffled and its order is fixed; hands 1 and 2 both use this order. At the start of hand 3 it is shuffled again; hands 3 and 4 both use the new order.

SEATS: Player A is seat 1 and Player B is seat 2. In each round r of a hand (r = 1 to 5), Seat X receives deck positions 6r-5, 6r-4 and 6r-3, and Seat Y receives positions 6r-2, 6r-1 and 6r. Positions 31 and 32 are never used (2 unused positions; 30 cards used per hand). In hands 1 and 3, Player A is Seat X and Player B is Seat Y. In hands 2 and 4 they swap: B is Seat X and A is Seat Y. So in hand 2 each player is dealt exactly the cards the other was dealt in hand 1, round by round, and likewise for hand 4 and hand 3.

ROWS: Each player builds a Front row (1 slot), a Middle row (2 slots) and a Back row (2 slots).

EACH ROUND:
(1) Deal: each player privately receives their 3 cards for this round.
(2) Card choice: at the same moment, each player secretly chooses 1 of their 3 cards to keep.
(3) Row choice: at the same moment, each player secretly names a row (Front, Middle or Back) for the kept card. If the named row is not full, the card goes there. If the named row is full, the card goes to the first row that is not full, checking in the order Back, Middle, Front.
(4) The 2 unkept cards are discarded. Discards are never shown to the opponent.
(5) Reveal: both kept cards are announced face up, with the row each went to.
After round 5 each player has exactly 5 placed cards, and the hand is scored.

ROW STRENGTH:
- Front = 2 x its card value (a Front 5 has strength 10).
- Middle and Back = the sum of the two card values, plus 100 if the two values are equal (a pair). For example 4 and 4 = 108; 3 and 6 = 9.

FOUL: a hand fouls if Front strength > Middle strength, or Middle strength > Back strength. Equal strengths are allowed and do not foul; otherwise the hand does not foul.

ROYALTIES (non-fouling players only; a fouling player earns none):
- Front card value 7 or 8: +1.
- Middle pair: +2.
- Back pair: +1.

SCORING EACH HAND:
- If neither player fouls, compare each row. The higher strength scores 1 point for its owner; equal strengths score nothing. A player who wins all three rows scores 3 more points (scoop). Each player then adds their own royalties.
- If exactly one player fouls, the other scores 6 plus their own royalties, and the fouler scores 0.
- If both foul, both score 0.
The hand scores are added to the match totals. All row strengths, both foul results and both hand scores are announced. Rows are then cleared for the next hand.

INFORMATION: Each player sees their own dealt cards and every revealed placement. Players may use anything seen in earlier hands. In hands 2 and 4 you know exactly which 3 cards your opponent is offered each round, because they are the cards you were offered in the previous hand. In hands 1 and 3 you know the opponent was offered the cards you are about to receive in the next hand.

WINNING: After round 20, the player with the higher match total (the sum of their four hand scores) wins. Equal totals are a draw (a shared win).
